name: Kaizen Surf School — private beginner lessons
summary: 1-to-1 or semi-private 2h lessons in Las Américas; board, wetsuit, insurance included. Strong for nervous beginners and friends.
area: Playa de Las Américas / Tenerife South
notes: Already planned category; ranked backup/primary bookable school with clear prices.

name: Surf Life Tenerife
summary: Established Las Américas school near Playa El Camisón; private and group beginner lessons; same hub as SUP.
notes: Closest practical school hub to Palm-Mar; WhatsApp +34 600 73 13 38.
rating: 5.0 (37 Tripadvisor/Viator — private double surf lesson listing)

name: El Médano private surf lessons
summary: Private beginner lessons on El Médano beach breaks; board and wetsuit included; windier conditions.
notes: 25–35 min from Palm-Mar; also see Sogni Canarias.

name: Surf Life Tenerife SUP — Playa El Camisón
summary: Flat-water beginner SUP behind breakwater; private, couple, and group formats with full gear.
notes: Best sheltered beginner SUP near base.

name: Aventura Excursions SUP Los Cristianos
summary: 2h lesson (1h instruction + 1h free paddle) or board rental for confident paddlers; south pick-up option.
notes: Slots typically 10:00, 12:30, 15:00.

name: El Médano paddle-surf classes
summary: Budget bay SUP lessons and rentals in El Médano.
notes: Windier than El Camisón.

name: Easy Kayak Tenerife — Palm-Mar kayak + snorkel
summary: Guided 2h sea-kayak + snorkel from Palm-Mar itself along the volcanic coast/cliffs; turtles common, dolphins if lucky. Small groups, no experience needed.
area: Palm-Mar (La Arenita beach) — walking distance / minutes from base
price: €45 adult guided (€40 pp groups of 4+); double-kayak rental €35/1h – €80/4h
notes: Closest possible option to the base; less crowded than Los Cristianos. Free cancellation. Platform ratings vary (Peek/Trip.com) — no Google/Tripadvisor score found.

name: Xplore Tenerife — turtle & dolphin kayak + snorkel (Los Cristianos)
summary: 3h guided kayak from Playa de Los Cristianos toward Cueva de los Enamorados / Palm-Mar cliffs with turtle snorkel; eco-certified kayaks.
area: Los Cristianos (Edificio Cristianmar, C. El Coronel 1)
notes: Most-reviewed kayak operator in the south; sightings not guaranteed. Product listing on Tripadvisor 4.5 (499).

name: Diving Atlantis — kayak to Palm-Mar Wall (dolphins)
summary: 2h guided kayak from Los Cristianos along the Palm-Mar cliff wall looking for dolphins; turtle-snorkel variant available.
price: From €39 adult (€18.50 child); turtle-snorkel variant from ~€22 listed (check site)
notes: Same centre as the snorkel/try-dive items — easy combo day. Also: https://divingatlantis.com/en/services/kayaking-tours/

name: Barbarian Diving — Try Scuba
summary: SSI beginner try-dive in Los Cristianos: briefing, confined practice, 1–2 guided ocean dives; small groups.
notes: Age 10+; credits toward SSI certification within 6 months.

name: Big Fish Tenerife — PADI Discover Scuba
summary: PADI 5★ Discover Scuba Dive: one ocean dive with instructor; all gear included.
notes: Age 10+; medical form required.

name: Diving Atlantis — Try Dive / DSD
summary: Flexible try-dive or PADI DSD with e-learning; shore or boat; turtle sites.
notes: Same center for snorkel combo.

name: Aqua Marina — Discover Scuba
summary: PADI Discover shore or boat; max 2 students per instructor; OW course available.
notes: Good if considering full certification during the trip.

name: Diving Atlantis — Rays Bay beach snorkel
summary: Guided 50-min snorkel in Bay of Stingrays with wetsuit and safety float; daily departures.

name: Diving Atlantis — turtle snorkel by boat
summary: Boat snorkel to secluded volcanic reefs for turtles and fish; afternoon departure.
notes: Sightings not guaranteed.

name: Palm-Mar / local turtle snorkel boat
summary: Short boat snorkel trips near Palm-Mar / Caleta; often bundled with whale boats.
price: €35–50 dedicated; or included in boat tours
notes: Very local to base accommodation.

name: Bahriyeli — no-chase eco whale watch
summary: Licensed 2h eco tour with no-chase policy and conservation donation; pilot whales and dolphins.
notes: Slots e.g. 10:30, 12:30, 14:30; availability into late 2026.

name: Kalima Kat — small-group catamaran (3h)
summary: Small catamaran (~22 guests) from Puerto Colón: cetacean spotting, swim + snorkel stop at a cove, snacks and drinks included.
notes: Best 'catamaran with friends' vibe — small and relaxed vs. the big 90-pax boats. Site shows a 300-review widget but no numeric score found.

name: Freebird catamaran — whale & dolphin cruise (3h / 4.5h Masca)
summary: Large catamaran from Puerto Colón; 3h Costa Adeje cruise or 4.5h to Los Gigantes cliffs & Masca Bay; food, drinks, swim stop, south hotel pickup included.
notes: Member of Tenerife Whale-watching Quality Charter; pickup included on 3h and 4.5h; crowded big-boat experience.

name: Peter Pan schooner whale watch
summary: Classic schooner; 2h watch or 3h lunch+swim (often near Palm-Mar).
notes: 3h typically Tue/Thu/Sat.

name: Civitatis yacht / schooner whale watch
summary: Shared yacht with lunch and swim or shorter schooner from Los Cristianos / Puerto Colón.
notes: Also schooner: civitatis.com schooner-whale-watching-cruise.

name: Teide National Park hike / Roques de García
summary: Volcanic day hike or guided park tour; best hiking logistics from Palm-Mar; optional cable car.
price: Free self-drive; guided €40–80; cable car extra
notes: Layers essential in October; peak trail needs permit.

name: Masca gorge / village hike
summary: Dramatic canyon descent requiring advance permit; boat return to Los Gigantes common.
notes: Capacity-limited — book early; more adventurous than Teide viewpoints.

name: Anaga Rural Park / Enchanted Forest
summary: Laurel-forest full-day guided hike with optional south pickup; long travel day.
notes: 1.5–2+ hrs from Palm-Mar each way; worth one dedicated day only.

name: Brisa Paragliding tandem Adeje
summary: Tandem flight from ~800m over Costa Adeje; standard, long, or acrobatic; free south pickup.
notes: Weather-dependent; 24h cancel for full refund.

name: Overfly Tenerife / Tenerfly tandem
summary: Alternative Adeje tandem operators with similar flight profiles.
notes: Also paraglidingadeje.com.

name: Buggy Safari Tenerife — 2h off-road
summary: Automatic buggy adventure with ~45 min off-road; free pickup Las Américas / Cristianos / Adeje.
notes: Driver 18+ with licence; departures 11:00, 13:00, 16:00.

name: Cancó Tenerife coastline / sunset buggy
summary: Coastline and sunset buggy safaris with Teide viewpoint photo stops.
notes: Sunset variant: cancotenerife.com sunset-buggy-tour-tenerife-south.

name: Tenerife First Excursions — Quad trip to Mt. Teide (3h)
summary: Guided quad ride on paved roads up through pine forest and lava fields into Teide National Park (~2,000 m); sunset variant; south hotel transfers included.
area: South Tenerife (transfers from south resorts) → Teide National Park
notes: Driver needs valid car licence. Road-based route (not off-road). Teide Sunset Quad listing: 5.0 (76 Tripadvisor).

name: Lava Land Tours — Teide Quad Safari (3.5h)
summary: 400cc automatic quads via Vilaflor to ~2,100 m in Teide National Park; day or sunset; max 4–6 quads; includes short off-road section outside the park.
area: South pickup → Vilaflor / Teide National Park
notes: Small groups; hotel pickup/drop-off in the south, fuel, helmet, insurance included. Also offers 2.5h Forest Explorer off-road quad.

name: Sunbonoo — quad safari Teide or Forest (3h)
summary: Teide route (80 km, up to 2,300 m, 3 stops) or off-road forest route; guide + snack; south transfer option.
area: South pickup (incl. Palm-Mar/Los Cristianos/Las Américas listed) → Teide
price: From €140 single quad without transfer (check site for double / transfer)
notes: Pickup list explicitly includes Palm-Mar-area resorts (Palmar/Los Cristianos/Las Galletas). Reseller listing.

name: Jet Ski Island Tenerife — guided jet-ski safari
summary: 1h guided safari on new Yamaha jet skis from Puerto Colón along the south coast with swim stop at La Caleta; max 4 jet skis per group; photo package optional.
price: Silver / Gold / Private tickets (check site; 20% online discount); GetYourGuide listings from ~€49
notes: Drive solo from 16; drive with passenger 18+; passengers from 6. Photos €30 extra (incl. in Gold); wetsuit €10.
rating: 4.6 (157 GetYourGuide — 'Tenerife Coast Jet Ski Tour with Photos' listing; not Google/Tripadvisor)

name: JetSki Puerto Colón — single or double jet-ski safari
summary: Guided Sea-Doo safari along Costa Adeje; 60 min total (~45 min on water); single or shared double jet ski.
price: €100 single rider / €120 total for 2 on one jet ski
notes: Clear published prices; double option good value for two friends. Arrive 30 min early.

name: GetYourGuide Costa Adeje jet-ski listings (compare)
summary: Marketplace of Puerto Colón / Las Galletas jet-ski tours (40 min–1h) with free cancellation; handy for comparing slots.
price: Listings from ~US$50–80 per jet ski (check site)
notes: Aggregator — pick a listing with high review counts; some Las Galletas options include Los Cristianos pickup.

name: Volcano Teide Sunset & Stars
summary: Exclusive evening cable car, Pico Viejo sunset, dinner, Starlight telescope session; south transfer available.
notes: Book ahead; warm closed shoes; no pregnancy/heart issues on cable car; age 8+.
rating: 4.4 (139 reviews on volcanoteide.com product page — not Google/Tripadvisor)

name: Teide sunset + stargazing safari (budget)
summary: Minivan sunset and stars tours without exclusive cable car; dinner packages available.
notes: Budget alternative if Sunset & Stars sold out.

name: Los Cristianos market
summary: Large outdoor produce and crafts market; easy morning from Palm-Mar.
notes: Tuesdays and Sundays; Tuesday quieter.

name: Fañabé / Costa Adeje markets
summary: Smaller resort markets for souvenirs and street food.
notes: Typically Thu & Sat — confirm locally.

name: Siam Park
summary: World-famous water park; October shoulder season usually means shorter queues.
notes: Book official tickets online; winter hours often to 17:00.

name: Teide + Masca combo coach tour
summary: Full-day sightseeing coach: Teide viewpoints, Masca village, sometimes north coast towns.
notes: Low-exertion overview day.

name: Los Gigantes / Masca catamaran cruise
summary: Cliff coastline boat with whale/dolphin watching and Masca Bay swim stop.
notes: Combines scenery + cetaceans. Operated on the Royal Delfin underwater-window catamaran (Puerto Colón pontoon 12); reseller page shows from €40, Royal Delfin direct lists 4.5h adult €60.
rating: 3.9 (855 Tripadvisor — Royal Delfin, the catamaran this product uses)

name: Costa Adeje beachfront / rooftop bars
summary: Upscale-casual cocktails and live music — chill friend night near Palm-Mar.
notes: Prefer over Veronica’s Strip for relaxed vibe.

name: Los Cristianos harbour bars (The Vault)
summary: Harbour cocktails and live music; more relaxed than Las Américas clubs.
notes: Example venue; check live schedule.

name: Utopia Parties — boat party & pool party
summary: Tenerife's long-running party brand: 3h open-bar DJ boat party from Puerto Colón (Wed/Sat/Sun) and Friday pool party at Monkey Beach Club (12:00–18:00). DUO ticket combines both.
area: Puerto Colón (boat) / Monkey Beach Club, Playa de Troya, Las Américas (pool)
price: Boat from €70 (standard open bar listed €80); pool party from €20–30 entry; DUO ticket discounts; Viator 2-day ticket from ~US$137
notes: Runs year-round, weekly — in-window days: boat Wed 7/14, Sat 10/17, Sun 11/18 Oct (Sun 4 Oct clashes with arrival); pool party Fri 9/16 Oct. Boat meet 15:30 summer time / 12:30 winter (clocks change 25 Oct → expect 15:30). Strictly 18+; stag/hen-heavy crowd.

name: Las Américas / Veronica’s Strip
summary: Dense tourist bar and club strip; loud party scene.
notes: Include for completeness; skip if preferring quieter nights.

name: elrow XXL Tenerife
summary: Large outdoor electronic carnival-style party at Golf Costa Adeje.
notes: +18; buy early; easy from Palm-Mar.

name: Eólica Festival
summary: Electronic + sustainability festival at ITER with major lineup, workshops, EcoMarket; shuttles from Los Cristianos.
notes: Standout trip-window event; south venue near base corridor.

name: Cross Popular Villa de Adeje
summary: Free 5 km community race and family events during Adeje fiestas.
notes: Register by ~7 Oct via Gesport Canarias.
